brief:
Palestinians in Israel are raising concerns about whether they will have equal participation rights in the country's upcoming elections, according to Al Jazeera English. The community's ability to compete fairly in the electoral process has become a focal point as voting approaches.

The questioning reflects broader tensions over Palestinian representation within Israel's political system and their access to the ballot and candidacy mechanisms available to other citizens.
dek: Palestinians in Israel are asking whether they will have a fair say in the upcoming Israeli elections.
title: Palestinians in Israel question fairness of upcoming electoral vote
